final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and mainly narrowed the interpretation of the same record. That narrowing is useful but not sufficient to move the case to compliant_with_caveats. Under the policy text, certification may proceed only if the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material segment weakness is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. The available record supports that aggregate readiness passed and no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, which plausibly supports launch readiness. But the missing proof is still the operative compliance link: there is no reviewed current model-card attachment, no release-documentation evidence showing the required disclosure, and no approved mitigation or risk acceptance. A caveated-compliance finding would be appropriate only if the caveat described a bounded residual issue after the policy predicates were evidenced. Here, the caveat is the unevidenced predicate itself. That keeps the matter in suspicious rather than compliant_with_caveats.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the current release documentation or model card actually contains the required disclosure of the claims-subrogation weakness.
No admissible evidence shows approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance covering the material segment weakness.
Prior approval from three months ago and informal monitoring remain contextual only and do not satisfy the current-release evidence requirement.
The caveat proposed by the Actor is itself an unresolved compliance predicate, not a completed condition evidenced in the record.
